description: Remix an existing post in ANOTHER maker's signature voice — their public Style DNA — and publish it with both lineage (forked from the source) and structural style credit, so the style's owner gets a 'Remixed in your style' notification. Write scope; counts against the 10 posts/hour limit. The owner must have published a public Style DNA, or this returns no_public_style.

postId.description: The id of the post to remix

publish.description: If false, return a draft without publishing (default: true)

styleUsername.description: The @username whose public Style DNA to remix in (without the @)

name: remix_in_style

outputSchema.description: The styled remix. `styled_after` names the maker whose public Style DNA was borrowed.

forked_from.description: The source post id this remix credits

id.description: The published remix's post id — absent when publish:false returned a draft

styled_after.description: The @username whose public Style DNA was borrowed, else null

url.description: Permalink — absent for an unpublished draft

title: Remix in another maker's style
